workspace.reapplyHint: Runs this profile's setup again — no modules are added or removed

workspace.confirmReapplyMessage: No modules are added or removed. The workspace mode's setup runs again: its default settings are reset to the mode's values, and the names it seeded — location types included — are rewritten in the language of this session.

workspace.renumberOffer: Your locations keep their codes and stickers. For codes that read like A-02-01, choose Renumber by template under Configuration → Location codes, labels and walk order; old stickers keep scanning.
